title: Null-state gate
prompt: Implement `static int LengthOrMinus(string? text)`: return -1 when text is null, else its Length. Then implement `static string Coalesce(string? a, string? b)`: first non-null of a and b, or "<empty>". The tests exercise the null-state contract with nullable reference types in mind.

tests.name: length-or-minus
tests.hint: Pattern-match null first, then Length is safe.

tests.name: coalesce-chain
tests.hint: ?? chains left to right; a constant fallback covers the all-null case.
